messages:
noah t: heads-up: post-canary we see ~0.3% failures in eu1 embeddings, root cause looks like quant kvcache type mismatch. planning an expedited hotfix in the late window.
maria chen: what's the rollout and rollback plan? need release note stub before approval.
noah t: patch = defensive type-check in kvcache lookup + regenerate tokenizer cache. perf bench: p50 +0.2ms, p95 unchanged. rollback = pin previous image v2026-03-embed-12, command: `/deploy rollback embeddings-eu1 v2026-03-embed-12`.
jen (oncall): given late window we should compress canary. propose 5% for 5m smoke, 50% for 8m, then 100% if metrics stay green. thresholds: error rate >0.6% OR p95 latency +15% -> rollback.
maria chen: relnotes draft: "hotfix: embeddings-eu1 guard for kvcache type mismatch + cache regen". will open PR now.
sre-bot: Deployment request created by noah t for service=embeddings-eu1 version=v2026-03-hotfix-23 image=sha256:aa11bb. Approvers: eng-release, sres, product.
noah t: kicking deploy with --expedite. `/deploy embeddings-eu1 v2026-03-hotfix-23 --pin --expedite --canary=5% --smoke=5m`
sre-bot: canary started at 1797771122. logs: https://go/logs/deploy/1797771111
jen (oncall): watching SLOs and tracing.
sre-bot: canary 5% after 5m: error rate=0.04%, p95 +0.1ms. green.
noah t: bumping to 50% for 8m.
sre-bot: 50% ramp complete at 1797771150.
jen (oncall): 6m into 50%: error rate 0.07%, latency stable. proceed to 100%.
sre-bot: final ramp to 100% complete at 1797771178. traffic=100%.
maria chen: relnotes PR merged and posted. emailed customers in the scheduled late window digest.
jen (oncall): marking expedited approval in thread. will keep watch for 30m. rollback cmd pinned above.
noah t: thanks everyone. will open postmortem if anything crops up, otherwise will close after watch window. :thumbsup:
